transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I’ve just been feeling persistently depressed and empty, and it feels like this heavy sadness won't leave me. It has been going on constantly for over two years now, about two years and two months to be exact.

During those two years, was there ever a period of 2 months or longer when you felt mostly not depressed? Also, have there been any stretches of at least 2 weeks when your depression became much worse than your usual baseline?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest. It feels like this low mood has just been fairly constant the whole time, without any real periods of feeling completely better. I don't think there have been any sudden, distinct worsenings either—it's just a continuous, heavy feeling.

Along with the low mood, have you had at least two of these most days for the past two years: poor appetite or overeating, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, low energy, low self-esteem, poor concentration, or feeling hopeless?

Yes, I've definitely struggled with having almost no energy and feeling completely worthless and hopeless about the future. I haven't really noticed any major issues with my sleep or appetite, but the constant fatigue and low self-esteem have been there almost every day for the past two years.

During this time, have you also had periods of at least 2 weeks with symptoms like losing interest or pleasure in things, major sleep or appetite changes, trouble concentrating, or thoughts of death or suicide?

No, I haven't really experienced those specific symptoms like major changes in my sleep or appetite, a loss of interest in things, or thoughts of suicide. My main struggle has just been the constant low mood, fatigue, and feelings of worthlessness over the past two years.
